svg.title: Example of a five-dollar daily billed ad-cost boundary
svg.desc: For most eligible campaigns, a two-dollar-fifty average daily budget corresponds to a five-dollar daily billed ad-cost limit and a seventy-six-dollar unchanged full-month example. Excludes taxes, fees and other campaigns; same-day higher budgets matter. All-day eligibility does not guarantee continuous visibility.

g.text: Worked example for Google's standard limits for most campaigns
Excludes taxes, fees and other campaigns. Higher budgets earlier that day affect the limit.
All-day eligibility is possible; continuous visibility and equal hourly spending are not guaranteed.
Source: Google Ads budget overview and budget-change rules • reviewed September 9, 2026
